item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible 2024 source showing Xi personally used explicit dehumanizing or revenge language against journalists, minorities, migrants, or religious groups. The record supports hostile nationalist framing, not a documented campaign of explicit hate incitement by Xi himself.","evidence":[{"title":"Xi told Blinken that China and the U.S. should be partners and maintain peaceful coexistence","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332906.html","summary":"This is a de-escalatory signal, not an incitement signal. It weighs against a reading that Xi was personally mobilizing hatred against foreign opponents in this bilateral context.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6","2B.7"]},{"title":"Wang Yi said China has no intention to displace or lord over anyone, warned against “threat inflation”","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-05-30","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332615.html","summary":"Official messaging attributed to Xi’s diplomatic line explicitly rejects threat inflation. That is the clearest counterweight to a claim of personal hate-mongering, though it remains rhetorical.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"China said it would promote peace talks on Ukraine, stop “fueling the fire,” and oppose bloc confrontation","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-05-27","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/wjbz/jh/202405/t20240527_11312271.html","summary":"This is anti-escalatory language that cuts against incitement-to-violence readings, at least in the Ukraine context. It does not prove restraint elsewhere, but it is relevant negative evidence.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.7"]},{"title":"Xi framed Taiwan as historically inseparable and reunification as part of national identity and historical destiny","publisher":"english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-04-11","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202404/11/content_WS6617c935c6d0868f4e8e5f4f.html","summary":"This is nationalist grievance framing. It is not explicit hate speech, but it uses historical destiny rhetoric that can mobilize hostility toward Taiwanese opponents and “separatists.”","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"Xi paired opposition to Taiwan independence and external interference with a national-rejuvenation narrative","publisher":"english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-02-09","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202402/09/content_WS65c5f9c7c6d0868f4e8e3e98.html","summary":"This is not a direct call for violence, but it is classic scapegoating language that defines opponents as existential threats to the nation.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"China publicly claimed it wanted peaceful cross-Strait development while opposing Taiwan independence and external interference","publisher":"english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua","date":"2024-03-05","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67b83c6d0868f4e8e4a62.html","summary":"The “peaceful development” language is a restraint claim, but the paired anti-separatist framing keeps the rhetoric adversarial and grievance-driven.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6","2B.7"]},{"title":"The PLA announced combat-readiness patrols, precision strikes, and a “stern warning” to Taiwan independence forces","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense / Xinhua","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/16310652.html","summary":"This is coercive signaling rather than personal hate speech, but it normalizes punitive language against a labeled enemy category. It supports a broader hostile-mobilization reading.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.2","2B.6"]},{"title":"China launched “punishment” drills around Taiwan days after Lai Ching-te’s inauguration","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-22","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-launches-war-games-around-taiwan-3453328","summary":"Reuters’ framing captures the punitive tone of the campaign: not merely defense, but punishment of a political opponent. That is not proof of ethnic hatred, but it is relevant to incitement through revenge framing.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.2","2B.6"]}]}
